key.name: strip-height
key.description: Height of the invisible trigger strip at the top of each monitor. The strip sits in the shell's input region, so this band swallows ALL pointer input - clicks, drags and hovers, not just scroll - and applications never see it. The default of 1 keeps that cost to a single row; the screen's top edge clamps the pointer to it, so throwing the mouse upwards always lands on the strip. Raise it only if you would rather hit the strip without touching the edge, and expect to lose window dragging and clicks in the band.

key.name: include-maximized
key.description: Cycle through windows maximized on both axes.

key.name: include-minimized
key.summary: Keep minimized windows in the cycle
key.description: When enabled, a minimized window stays in the cycle so scrolling can restore it.

key.name: wrap-around
key.description: Continue from the first window after the last one.

key.name: gesture-timeout-ms
key.description: Idle time after which the frozen window order is discarded and rebuilt from the most-recently-used order.

key.name: switch-debounce-ms
key.description: Guards against flying past windows when the mouse emits a burst of scroll events.

key.name: invert-direction
key.description: Swap which direction scrolling up moves through the window list.

key.name: show-osd
key.summary: Show the window title on switch
key.description: Display an on-screen label naming the window that was switched to.
